items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I was going with a girl named Valetta.

ctx.x: Now I worked...I was a friend of Ellis Burton.. I had a problem with a woman and Ellis told...so, I'm told he said to a policemen that"It you say anything else to Sammy Price, don't come around me any more."

But anyway, I stayed my time out in Kansas City and I felt like, I guess, a disciple, that I was supposed to stay in a certain place, you know, until my time was out and then move on. In the meanwhile, I opened a restaurant in Topeka, Kansas. I was going with a girl named Valetta. I wrote a song...
